test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘EXIST’ is written as ‘FYHTU’ and ‘ABOVE’ is written as ‘BCNWF’. How will ‘WORLD’ be written in that language?
solution:
TB Solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘EXIST is written as FYHTU’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f14e521c071db6958eafae9a32603651286f9283ad6d1e9fce83b61661267dd4.png] 

For, 'ABOVE is written as BCNWF',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d0f482659c9367fa67c2e64b1819d3cfe638f40bc1082630d5a60ff38582d15.png] 

Similarly, for 'WORLD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f1348df152fbbb81b765785e72d708bc479f781e048b3b307afbad677daba5f.png] 

So, 'WORLD' will be written as 'XPQME'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
